summary:
Iter133 pre-deploy P8 QA sweep — overall GREEN with 1 critical frontend issue found AND FIXED during testing. Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_iter133_predeploy.py = 34 PASS / 1 SKIP (35 tests). All 20 Safety Export combos (10 endpoints x csv/pdf) return 200 with Safety/HR/Admin tokens; CSV has Content-Disposition: attachment + text/csv; PDF returns text/html starting with <!doctype html>; PM token + anonymous correctly rejected with 401. P3 R2 degraded-mode flip verified end-to-end via direct mongo insert: baseline green -> insert {at: ISO_str} into db.r2_degraded_events -> card flips to status='red' detail starts with 'DEGRADED' -> cleanup -> back to green. P4 Weekly Digest: GET returns enabled/recipients[]/weekday/hour_utc/dashboard_url/last_run; PATCH with {recipients,hour_utc} persists across GET; PATCH {} -> 400; send-now in preview env -> {ok:true, sent:false}; send-now with enabled=false -> 409; non-admin token -> 401. Regression iter120/126/128/129/130/132 = 111/111 passing in 63 s. Performance: all 10 export endpoints return in 98-122 ms (target <800 ms; executive <500 ms) — well under budget.

Frontend: One CRITICAL compile blocker FOUND AND FIXED in /app/frontend/src/components/AdminShell.jsx line 17 — duplicate `Mail` import from lucide-react caused 'Identifier Mail has already been declared' SyntaxError, which blocked the ENTIRE app (webpack overlay covered every page incl. safety/login, hr/login, pm/login, admin/login). Removed the second Mail and webpack recompiled clean (200 OK). After fix, P5 nav uniformity verified: HR portal has all 4 testids (hr-nav-home/hr-nav-back/hr-change-password/hr-sign-out) PRESENT; PM portal has pm-change-password + pm-sign-out PRESENT; admin-nav-digest-config sidebar entry PRESENT; /admin/digest-config renders with data-testid='admin-digest-config-page' + all 7 digest action testids (toggle, recipients, weekday, hour, save, preview, send-now) PRESENT. Safety nav testids exist in code (SafetyShell.jsx lines 29/32/46/56) but live UI verification skipped due to safety login URL matching false-positive in playwright script — code inspection confirms they are wired correctly. GO recommendation for deploy.

minor.issue: Code at /app/backend/routes/admin_ops.py:72 compares mongo field `at` as ISO string vs `since` ISO string — works correctly ONLY because /app/backend/routes/safety_portal/documents.py:83 stores `at` as `datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()`. If any future logger writes a datetime object instead of ISO string, the count_documents will silently return 0 and the alert will never fire. Recommend normalizing on one type (ideally BSON datetime) and converting in the query.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate `Mail` import from lucide-react on line 17 (already imported on line 15) caused SyntaxError that blocked the ENTIRE frontend with a webpack error overlay. FIXED IN-TEST by removing the second occurrence.

action_items: (Recommended) Normalize `r2_degraded_events.at` to BSON datetime (or document the ISO-string contract) so a future logger swap can't silently disable R2 alerts.
(Optional) Add a lint/CI guard against duplicate imports (e.g., eslint no-duplicate-imports) — the AdminShell.jsx dup-Mail would have been caught at PR time.

(Cosmetic) The safety login playwright check matched `**/safety-portal**` even on /safety-portal/login URL — not a product bug, just a test selector caveat; live testids in SafetyShell.jsx are present per code inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: safety_exports.py: clean, 10 endpoints each ~25 LoC, shared _serve()/_csv_response()/_html_report() helpers, all gated via require_token DI — no admin-token leak, no _id leakage (find({}, {'_id':0})).

admin_digest_config.py: env-default merge with DB-override merge, PATCH validates via Pydantic + ge/le ranges (weekday 0..6, hour_utc 0..23, recipients max_length=20), send-now correctly 409s on disabled, preview-mode sent=False when AUTO_EMAIL_REPORTS!=true.
admin_ops.py R2 card: 24h window via count_documents with $gte — correct logic, but see minor issue above re ISO-string-only comparison.
P1 perf: 98-122 ms across all 10 exports (target <800 ms) — count_documents and indexed reads only, no full collection scans observed; ~3.7-8.2× under budget.

success_rate.backend: 100% (34/34 testable + 1 documented skip for direct-DB scenario verified separately; 111/111 regression PASS)
success_rate.frontend: 100% post-fix (HR 4/4, PM 2/2, Admin sidebar+page+7/7 digest testids all PRESENT; Safety testids present in code)

context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminShell.jsx duplicate Mail import was fixed in-test (line 17). If anyone re-introduces it, the entire frontend will fail to compile. Add eslint no-duplicate-imports to prevent regression. conftest.py auto-injects X-Admin-Token via setdefault — for negative-auth tests use headers={'X-Admin-Token': ''} to bypass. Safety login wait_for_url('**/safety-portal**') is too loose — it matches /safety-portal/login too; use a more specific suffix like '**/safety-portal' (no /login) for real success detection.

go_no_go_recommendation.rationale: All 20 Safety export combos return 200 with correct content-type + auth gating; Weekly Digest admin config GET/PATCH/send-now/disabled-409/empty-body-400 all behave per spec; R2 degraded-mode card flips red on event insert verified end-to-end; portal nav uniformity testids all present (HR 4/4, PM 2/2, Admin digest sidebar+page+7 actions); 111/111 regression unchanged; export endpoints 5-8x under perf budget. The only critical issue (AdminShell duplicate import) was fixed during testing. Deferred items P2 (FE uploads) and P7 (CA deep linking) confirmed out of scope.
